tie_analysis.note: tol 1e-9 in barycentrics; ambiguous means >=2 non-degenerate faces hit the same point at the same t

tests.bvh_mod_rs_diff: +57/-1 vs c7b5d7f (mesh mount, vertices_from_f64, MeshBvhError Display/Error)

findings_non_blocking.title: degenerate mesh valid face 1 (0,1,3) is never hit by the committed 16-ray set
findings_non_blocking.detail: valid faces are 1,2,3; hit faces are only 2,3. Face 1 lies in the z=0 plane and needs a -z front-side ray, but the 12 centre rays use +-x, +y, +z. Coverage gap, not a skipped or relaxed comparison; README's '3 valid face centres x 4 directions' overstates coverage.

findings_non_blocking.title: README/comment 'rays avoid exact vertex/edge hits' does not match the committed set
findings_non_blocking.detail: independent exact math finds at least 10 exact edge/vertex hits among the 16 degenerate rays (e.g. ray 13 through shared vertex (0,0,0) with u=v=0; ray 3 has two exact hits at the same t=3.3333 on faces 2 and 3 but both are back-face culled, so the outcome stays unique). The correct description is 'avoid ambiguous ties that survive culling'.

findings_non_blocking.title: the replaced first-version ray is not archived
findings_non_blocking.detail: no bit pattern / coordinates for the removed ray exist in the fixture, scripts or evidence; the original 'reference face 2 / product face 1' observation cannot be audited bit-by-bit. Recommend recording removed rays in the receipt in later slices.

adsjudication: The sample replacement is not a defect-hiding workaround: a through-shared-vertex hit is an inherent layout-dependent tie (QA constructed such a ray: 3 non-degenerate faces at identical t), which the acceptance explicitly excludes from face assertions; the committed 436+16 rays contain no ambiguous tie, no ray is skipped and no tolerance is relaxed.
